name: io.github.a32116150-ctrl/verify402-mcp
title: verify402
description: Free x402 preflight gate plus paid on-chain truth checks for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key for a dedicated hot wallet. Omit for the free preflight_gate only. verify402-mcp@1.0.9 (this published release) defaults paid calls to Base Sepolia testnet (eip155:84532) for the public demo. Base mainnet (eip155:8453) is an explicit opt-in for a separate deployment and is not enabled by this release. Fund only Base Sepolia testnet USDC for the demo. Never use a main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY402_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated EVM payment networks for paid calls. Default Base Sepolia testnet (eip155:84532); set eip155:8453 explicitly for Base mainnet. The supported network-to-canonical-asset map is constrained to Base Sepolia and Base mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on one x402 payment in USD (default 0.25). Enforced before signing.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional cap for total spend per UTC day across restarts.
